title: test(mcpx): plumb one run seed through tests and CI (#1949)
body: Implements the still-missing run-seed transport from #1949 (Approach C), reusing the landed `gen` derivation (#1956) and seedstore/collector (#1953). Queue task 13250. ## What lands - **`internal/testsupport/seed`** — the lazy helper. `MCPX_TEST_SEED` is read only when a test asks for a stream (`seed.Source(t, "name", version)`), so unrelated packages stay cacheable; there is no TestMain anywhere. Set + valid → used as-is (any `[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}` id replays; only wrapper/CI mint, and they mint UUIDv7). Unset in CI → fail closed. Unset locally → mint once per process with a warning. On failure the helper logs the exact one-command replay. The package doc is the #172 test-only env allowlist entry (same shape as `MCPX_TEST_REQUIRE`'s). - **`pkgs/mcpx/scripts/test.sh`** — the wrapper entrypoint: mints once if unset (warns, records to gitignored `.cache/test-seed/`), validates, exports the seed to every `go test` process, derives `-shuffle` from the same seed, fails closed in CI. Root `.gitignore` gains a negation so the script is tracked despite the `test.*` rule. - **`mcpx.yml`** — new `seed` job mints one UUIDv7 per run (or accepts the new `workflow_dispatch` `seed` input for exact replay), uploads `seed.json` as the `test-seed` artifact the #1953 collector files into `testdata/seeds/v1`, and `test` / `stress-pr` / `stress-nightly` now `need` it and receive `MCPX_TEST_SEED`. The stress jobs derive `-shuffle` from the run seed instead of `RUN_IDENTITY`; re-running failed jobs reuses the seed because the successful seed job is not re-run. - **`mcpx-test.yml`** — `init` mints and outputs the seed; `unit` and `e2e` jobs receive it; the wrapper regression tests run in the unit job. - **`TESTING.md`** — run-seed section: wrapper usage, the bare-`go test` per-package limitation, CI behaviour, replay. ## Verification - `go test ./internal/testsupport/seed/ ./internal/seedstore/ -count=1` — pass (laptop). `go vet` clean, `gofmt` clean, `bash -n` clean. - Wrapper unittest (`scripts/tests/test_mcpx_test_seed.py`, fake-`go` oracle: asserts the exact argv + env the test process receives) — 4 tests pass. - The shuffle derivation is implemented three times (Go helper, wrapper, workflow python) and cross-checked: seed `01a0f101-2378-7c1c-9dc1-5a1ae1571eca` → `6825000031865948415` in all three. The Go test restates the formula from #1949 section 2 with raw sha256 as its oracle, and pins `Mint` against `seedstore.Timestamp` (the store's independent UUIDv7 parser). - Both workflow files parse as YAML; job graph checked (`seed` has no needs; `budget`'s existing needs are unaffected). ## Pre-existing failure (not a regression) `internal/testsupport/gen` `TestConfigLayersProperty` fails identically on a clean worktree at origin/main `6f1efc4424` — the merged-servers map leaks the host machine's real mcpx config into the fixture expectation. Filed as #7686. Scope guards honoured: PR #5127 untouched; the landed derivation/store work is reused, not redone. Closes the transport remainder of #1949. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
